products.name: Lithophane Light Box
products.shortDescription: Your own photograph, printed into a panel that reveals it when lit.
products.description: A lithophane is a photograph printed as varying thickness rather than ink - it looks like a pale panel until it is lit from behind, and then the image appears. The frame measures 13cm x 18cm, and the printed panel is 180:127 - close to A4 proportions.

options.label: Your photograph
options.help: Best results come from a photo in roughly 180:127 proportions (about A4 shape) - bright, high contrast, plain background, subject large in the frame. Dark or busy photos do not render well. We will tell you before printing if yours will not work.

options.label: Gift note
options.help: Hand-written on a card and included in the parcel.

products.name: Verse Light Box
products.shortDescription: A verse of your choosing, lit softly from behind.
products.description: A layered panel carrying the words you choose, lit from behind so the text glows. The frame measures 14.4cm x 19.5cm. If your text does not sit neatly in those proportions we will do our best to fit everything in.

options.label: Verse text
options.help: Up to 240 characters. Printed exactly as typed - please check it carefully.

options.label: Orientation
options.help: The photo updates to show the shape you pick.

options.label: Gift note
options.help: Hand-written on a card and included in the parcel.

products.name: Location Plaque
products.shortDescription: A plaque marking a place that matters, and the day it did.
products.description: A keepsake plaque built around a place - where you were married, baptised, graduated, or simply somewhere that means something. Tell us the location and we design the plaque around it.

options.label: What would you like on the plaque?
options.help: This is the wording printed across the plaque. Most people use a name and the occasion together - "Justin's Baptism", "Sarah & Daniel's Wedding", "Class of 2026".

options.label: Location
options.help: The place this plaque marks - a church, a address, a city, wherever it was.

options.label: Gift note
options.help: Hand-written on a card and included in the parcel.

products.name: Acrylic Verse Keychain
products.shortDescription: A slim acrylic keychain carrying a verse, in three sizes.
products.description: A small acrylic keychain printed with a verse of your choosing. The larger sizes give the words more room, so a longer passage needs a bigger piece.

options.label: Verse text
options.help: The limit changes with the size you pick: 105 characters on small, 140 on medium, 300 on large.

options.label: Gift note
options.help: Hand-written on a card and included in the parcel.

products.name: Breadclip Bookmark with Verse
products.shortDescription: The breadclip bookmark, carrying a verse of your choosing.
products.description: Shaped like the humble bread tag so it clips onto the page rather than sitting loose in it - and printed with the verse you want to keep coming back to.

options.label: Verse text
options.help: Printed exactly as typed - please check it carefully.

options.label: Name (optional)
options.help: Space is tight on a clip - short words work best.

products.name: Bible Opener
products.shortDescription: A slim tool for turning thin Bible pages cleanly.
products.description: Thin Bible paper is difficult to turn without creasing or catching two pages at once. This slim opener slides between the pages and lifts one cleanly.

products.name: Car Plate Keychain
products.shortDescription: A miniature number plate, printed with your registration.
products.description: A small plate keychain printed with the registration of your choosing - a good gift for a new driver, or a first car.

options.label: Plate text
options.help: Up to 8 characters, printed exactly as typed including spacing.

products.name: Bumper Plate Keychain
products.shortDescription: A miniature weight plate, personalised with your text.
products.description: A small bumper plate keychain - for the person whose week is organised around training days.

options.label: Text on the plate
options.help: A name, a number, or a short word.

products.name: Breadclip Keychain
products.shortDescription: A bread tag keychain reading Our Daily Bread.
products.description: A miniature bread tag on a ring, printed with "Our Daily Bread". Small, cheap, and strangely satisfying - the sort of thing that ends up on everyone's keys and bags.
